title: Surfing the Activation Wave: Analyzing the Information and Geometry of LLM Hidden States for Speculative Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2610.12939v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Decoder hidden states from different layers of large language models (LLMs) often encode complementary information. However, existing speculative decoding methods typically rely on a small set of target-model layers chosen using fixed, position-based heuristics. Selecting an optimal subset of layers is inherently a combinatorial problem, making exhaustive evaluation infeasible even for moderately deep models. In this work, we present a principled framework for multi-layer hidden-state selection for speculative decoding based on two complementary criteria: informativeness, measured through matrix-entropy analysis, and diversity, quantified using centered kernel alignment (CKA). We investigate layer-wise Shannon entropy, aggregate entropy under hidden-state concatenation, and pairwise CKA dynamics across depth, revealing distinct geometric and informational compartments within decoder representations. translated_title: 冲浪激活波：面向推测解码的大语言模型隐藏状态信息与几何特性分析
translated_abstract: 来自大语言模型（LLM）不同层的解码器隐藏状态通常编码互补信息。然而，现有的推测解码方法通常依赖于通过固定的、基于位置的启发式规则所选的少量目标模型层。选择最优的层子集本质上是一个组合问题，即使对于中等深度的模型，穷举式评估也不可行。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个用于推测解码的多层隐藏状态选择的原则性框架，该框架基于两个互补的准则：信息量——通过矩阵熵分析来度量；多样性——使用中心化核对齐（CKA）来量化。我们研究了逐层的香农熵、隐藏状态拼接下的聚合熵，以及跨网络深度的成对CKA动态，从而揭示了解码器表示中截然不同的几何与信息分区。基于这些发现，我们提出了……
tldr: 该论文提出了一个基于矩阵熵信息量分析与中心化核对齐（CKA）多样性度量的原则性框架，用于为大语言模型推测解码选择多层隐藏状态，并揭示了解码器表示中的几何与信息分区特性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a principled framework for multi-layer hidden-state selection in LLM speculative decoding based on matrix-entropy informativeness and CKA diversity, revealing distinct geometric and informational compartments within decoder representations.
